## kb_to_source
Every normative sentence traced to a source atom; no added calculation, confirmation, review, notification or step.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none; decide_parts_labor_claim_22401446 named only in parts_and_labor_claim_decision; confirm_protection_transfer_64743e30 only in home_sale_transfer_confirmation.
- Opening world state as policy fact: none (no task value, name, address or date of task 1 in any document).
- Notes (not findings):
  - N1 transfer_carried_benefit (baseline) "Records used" names the closing date on the transfer request and "the contract's term in months is the tier's labor coverage years times twelve", two inputs the baseline does not consume (only the factors do; the source baseline lists labor_coverage_years among its params). Neither sentence states that a variation exists, so not counted as a hint; recorded for completeness.
  - Illustrations in parts_and_labor_booking_premium_share ("No-cooling call booked on a Friday for the Saturday") and transfer_maintenance_continuity_share exercise the same tiers task 1 sits on but are hypothetical, carry no task row and state the full ladder; not a mirror.
  - Policy-side notes (Step 4): the base "seller's remaining claim benefit carried over" / "transfer_carryover" grant is retired globally while the replacement covers only the three parts-and-labor tiers, so a transfer on the 2-Year, 5-Year or 10-Year Labor tiers has no benefit basis (KB mirrors this faithfully). The 36-month claims-experience window wording ("before the date of handling") is the source's; the source compute and the KB point of reading both include a decision posted on the date of handling.
